answer: The raven register is checked at draw time, bridge lists the eligible set, and whisper seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 87 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time a hostile operator pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 87 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh fleet has no way to grade its own output. Collateral of 62 dollars is at risk. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
